summary: The Petitioner, Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (herein referred to as “Petitioner”), has filed the present Petition for adoption of tariff for setting up of 1200 MW ISTSconnected Wind Power Projects anywhere in India under _the “Guidelines for Tariff Based Competitive Bidding Process for Procurement of Power from Grid Connected Wind Power Projects”_ vide Gazette of India dated 26.07.2023, including subsequent amendments and clarifications thereto (hereinafter “Competitive Bidding guidelines, 2023”).
